meta.note: Stand-in names for every real place and name on the modelled campus. The game never uses official Purdue names. This file is the source of truth; nothing in the game reads it yet. Codes are callout codes derived from the folk name and never equal the real official code. Streets and natural geography keep their real names until the owner decides. "osm" is the OpenStreetMap id carried over from data/campus.json (or data/raw/osm-campus.json); null where the place has no OSM building.
